title: Scout Client
description: An optimised, modern Minecraft client with refined optimisations for any computer.
body:
# Scout Client

Scout Client is a highly efficient and optimised client for the best balance of QOL and performance.


<details>
<summary>Optimisations/Improvements</summary>

- Better memory usage
- Dynamic FPS usage
- Faster loading
- Faster Chunks
- Overlay optimisations
- Light optimisations
- Terrain generation optimisations
- Texture fixes

</details>


<details>
<summary>Features</summary>

- Game immersion
  - Ambient Sounds
  - More Footstep sounds
- UI Enhancements (TBC)
- Camera zoom
- No chat restrictions
- Animations
- Detailed crash logs
- Crash helper
- Shaders
- Inventory Immersion
  - Item highlighting
  - Particles
  - Sounds
- Voice chat
- Map
- All-version compatiability (ViaVersion)

</details>


<details>
<summary>About Scout</summary>

Scout Client has 2 versions: [Scout Client](https://modrinth.com/modpack/scout-client) and [Scout Perform](http://modrinth.com/modpack/scout-perform) (To Be Released). Scout Perform is the absolute best performance you can get BUT with a smaller compatiability range with extra mods whilst Scout Client is the perfect blend of both.

</details>
